shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure with arms extended and legs shown
horizontal band of repeating geometric ornament (belt / carved band)
row of repeated similar motifs across the upper part
animal heads in profile with open jaws
elongated tapering pendant forms hanging downward
justification: Both surfaces show a frontal splayed anthropomorph together with a horizontal band of repeating geometric ornament and repeated profile animal heads, and in both, elongated tapering forms hang downward beneath a horizontal element. But A is a single flat, brightly polychrome outline drawing dominated by one centered figure, while B is a monochrome shallow relief on stone organised into stacked registers with scattered small animals, so the manner of rendering and the compositional logic scarcely correspond.
